notes: Two object markers, both unrepresented; the ASV writes their objects bare (rule 16).
The infinitive phrase is divided under rule 52: that on לַ, ye should do on the infinitive.

No article morpheme stands in the כל עדת בני ישראל chain, so both written the's are supplied and go to the expressions they determine (rule 15); the copula joins the predicate noun דְּבָרִים, not the demonstrative subject (rule 20).
